description: Agent Learning: submit the experience episodes an agent went through with the lesson records captured from them: each episode with its id, its kind (a task, a success, a failure, an incident, a correction, a surprise or a near miss), when it happened, the context it happened in, its log as written, read for lesson wording such as next time, lesson learned, should have or root cause, and optionally how many lessons it carries as recorded; each lesson record with its id, the id of the source episode it records, the date of the experience, when the record was written, the context it was learned in and the lesson as recorded; and optionally the days a record may follow its experience (7 when left out). The signed report gives every episode with the lesson wording read from it, the lessons it carries, the records that capture them and its status as captured, partly_captured, uncaptured, no_lesson or unconfirmed, every record with its days after the experience and its status as complete, empty, unsourced, undated, no_context or late, and counts the lessons carried, the records and the lessons left uncaptured, and names experience left uncaptured: episodes that carry a lesson with no lesson record and records that state no lesson; then records with no source episode, no date or no context, and records written long after the experience, with the fix for each. This reads the agent’s own experience captured as lessons: whether outside feedback on one piece of work was incorporated is wever_feedback-incorporation-check, promises captured from messages are wever_commitment-capture-check, and incident claims read against a postmortem are wever_incident-evidence-check. Verdict experience_not_captured, capture_incomplete, capture_informal or experience_captured. POST /api/learning-capture-check. Reads only the recorded episodes, lessons and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no lesson is written, changed or retired and no memory or model is updated. Agent Learning reads whether an agent improves from its own experience, from the lessons it captures to the lessons it keeps: it is not the loop on feedback received (whether outside feedback was incorporated, the wever_feedback checks; learning begins where that ends and reads the agent’s own lesson records over time), not a knowledge store (stored knowledge and its retrieval, the wever_knowledge checks; learning is improvement from experience), not memory design (how memory is structured, wever_memory-design-check; this family reads what the lessons in it are worth), not the confidence an agent states in its answers (the wever_uncertainty checks) and not the promises it makes (the wever_commitment checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-learning-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-learning/.
